recoveredInquiryResults.result:
# Harbor Water Pilot Analysis Report

## Summary
The requested analysis cannot be completed as the available documents do not contain information about operating costs, installation constraints, council requirements, audit reconciliation, or ledgers. The documents searched contain only trial results and maintenance data for Cedar and Birch water treatment systems.

## Evidence Found

### Trial Results (Page 1, lines 5-8)
"The fictional Harbor water pilot compared the Cedar and Birch treatment systems over 30 days. Cedar delivered 1200 liters per day; Birch delivered 900 liters per day. Both met the drinking-water quality target. Cedar used 6 kWh per day and Birch used 3 kWh per day. Figures refer to the same operating conditions, not annual forecasts." [Harbor Water Pilot](attachment://3b32f5401dfe/page/1)

### Maintenance Requirements (Page 1, lines 9-12)
"Cedar requires filter inspection every 7 days; Birch requires it every 14 days. The pilot measured no winter performance. Neither system has established annual reliability from this short pilot. Do not treat a 30-day result as an annual guarantee." [Harbor Water Pilot](attachment://3b32f5401dfe/page/1)

### Key Limitations
- **No winter performance data**: The pilot "measured no winter performance"
- **No annual reliability**: "Neither system has established annual reliability from this short pilot"
- **No operational cost data**: Operating costs were not measured or reported in the trial
- **No installation specifications**: Installation constraints were not documented
- **No audit/ledger reconciliation**: No financial audit or ledger documents were provided

## Missing Information
The following critical information required to complete the requested analysis was not found in any available document:

| Information Requested | Status |
|----------------------|--------|
| Operating cost comparison | NOT FOUND |
| Installation constraints | NOT FOUND |
| Council requirements | NOT FOUND |
| Audit document | NOT FOUND |
| Ledger document | NOT FOUND |
| Audit-ledger reconciliation | NOT FOUND |

## Conclusion
The available documents contain only trial performance data (capacity and energy use) and maintenance schedules for Cedar and Birch systems. They do not contain the financial, operational, or regulatory information required to compare operating costs, installation constraints, or council requirements. Without audit and ledger documents, it is impossible to reconcile financial data or determine the feasible option for the council.

The trial data (Cedar: 1200L/day, 6kWh/day; Birch: 900L/day, 3kWh/day) shows Birch is more energy-efficient, but without cost data, this cannot determine cost-effectiveness. The 30-day trial period is insufficient to establish annual reliability, and winter performance remains unmeasured for both systems.

**Recommendation**: The council requires additional documentation including operating cost analysis, installation specifications, council requirements, and audit/ledger reconciliation before a feasible option can be determined.

Sources:
- [Harbor Water Pilot](attachment://3b32f5401dfe/page/1)
